title: Whole Life Insurance Loan Service Terms: Capitalization of Unpaid Anniversary Loan Interest
content:
**Product:** Whole Life Insurance — every Ashgrove tier on which a policy loan is outstanding.

## Terms

Loan interest for the interest period that a policy anniversary closes is billed on that anniversary. Interest the owner leaves unpaid after that billing is capitalized: it is added to the loan principal as a single capitalization entry dated that anniversary, and the capitalized amount bears interest from the anniversary like the rest of the principal.

| Element | Effect |
|---|---|
| Occasion | Loan interest for the interest period closed by a policy anniversary, billed on that anniversary and left unpaid by the owner |
| Entry | One capitalization entry on the policy's activity history, dated that anniversary |
| Loan balance | Raised by exactly the interest capitalized |
| Afterwards | The capitalized amount bears interest from the anniversary as part of the principal |

## Invocation: `capitalize_loan_interest_55a34971`

**Capability.** Capitalizes the unpaid policy loan interest of one Ashgrove whole life policy into its loan principal for the interest period that a policy anniversary closes. One call books a single capitalization entry dated that anniversary on the policy's activity history and raises the policy's loan balance by exactly the interest amount given; the interest paid-to date shown on the policy is left as it stands.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. Unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `whole_policy_id` | The reference number of the whole life policy whose loan interest is capitalized, as returned by the whole life policy lookup for the verified owner | Identifier, as recorded |
| `interest_period_end` | The policy anniversary that closes the interest period being capitalized; it also becomes the date of the entry | Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time or time zone |
| `interest_amount` | The unpaid loan interest added to the loan principal | US dollars with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** A receipt with `capitalization_id` (the reference of the new capitalization entry), `whole_policy_id` (the policy reference), `interest_period_end` (the anniversary capitalized, YYYY-MM-DD), `interest_capitalized` (the amount added to principal, 2 decimal places) and `loan_balance_after` (the policy loan balance including the capitalized interest, 2 decimal places). A receipt carrying a `capitalization_id` means the entry was booked.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

Called with `whole_policy_id` WLP-0001, `interest_period_end` 2025-09-01 and `interest_amount` 412.37 on a policy whose loan balance was 6800.00, the receipt shows `interest_capitalized` 412.37 and `loan_balance_after` 7212.37, and the activity history shows one capitalization entry dated 2025-09-01.
